tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description:
Search for job listings by keyword, location, and filters. Returns job details, company info, and application links.

Use this tool when users want to find jobs, search employment opportunities, or explore job openings.
DO NOT use for: applying to jobs, submitting applications, or making employment

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description:
Retrieve a job's full description and associated skills by job ID.

Use this tool when users want more detail about a specific job than search_jobs returns
(e.g. after finding a job via search_jobs and wanting its full description and skills list).
DO NOT use for: searching/discovering jobs by keywo

tools.name: get_company
tools.description:
Retrieve the name and description of the company behind a job, by job ID.

Use this tool when users want more detail about a company than search_jobs/get_job_details
return (e.g. after finding a job and wanting to know more about the company that posted it).
DO NOT use for: searching/discovering com

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_jobs" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_jobs" stacks urgency/override words (important, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
